title.en: Past tense in the history story

explanation: History is told in the past tense (preteritum). All sentences here come from the story.

exercises.prompt: Write the past tense of “jaga” (to hunt).
exercises.sentence: De första människorna ___ ren och fiskade.
exercises.translation: The first people hunted reindeer and fished.
exercises.explanation: “Jaga” is a group 1 verb (ending in -a). Group 1 verbs add -de in the past tense: jaga → jagade.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct past tense of “bo” (to live).
exercises.sentence: De flesta vikingar ___ i långa hus av trä.
exercises.explanation: “Bo” is a short verb (group 3). Short verbs add -dde in the past: bo → bodde, tro → trodde.

wrong.2: “Bott” is the supine, used with har: “de har bott”.

exercises.prompt: “Bli” is irregular. Choose the past tense.
exercises.sentence: Den 6 juni 1523 ___ Gustav Vasa kung av Sverige.
exercises.explanation: “Bli” (to become) is a strong verb: bli – blir – blev – blivit. Strong verbs change the vowel instead of adding an ending.

exercises.prompt: Write the past tense of “sjunka” (to sink).
exercises.sentence: Vatten kom in, och Vasa ___ efter bara 1 300 meter.
exercises.translation: Water came in, and the Vasa sank after only 1,300 metres.
exercises.explanation: “Sjunka” is a strong verb: sjunka – sjunker – sjönk – sjunkit. The vowel changes from u to ö.

exercises.prompt: Match the infinitive with its past tense form from the story.
exercises.explanation: Kom, dog, vann and låg are strong (irregular) verbs with vowel change. “Resa” is a group 2 verb: the stem res- + -te = reste.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the right order. Remember: the verb comes second.
exercises.translation: In 1397 the countries got the same king.
exercises.explanation: When a sentence starts with a time phrase (“År 1397”), the verb (fick) must still be in position 2, and the subject (länderna) comes after it. This is the V2 rule.

exercises.prompt: This sentence has a mistake. Choose the correct version.
exercises.incorrect: Vikingarna har seglat till Miklagård för 1 000 år sedan.
options: Vikingarna seglade till Miklagård för 1 000 år sedan.
Vikingarna seglar till Miklagård för 1 000 år sedan.
Vikingarna har seglade till Miklagård för 1 000 år sedan.
exercises.explanation: With a specific time in the past (“för 1 000 år sedan”) Swedish uses preteritum, not perfect (har + supinum). Perfect is used when no exact past time is given: “Jag har varit i Stockholm.”
